desc: Read N and the list of N distinct integer coordinates X.
Analyze the operation and discover the error in the PLAN: the sum of 4 pieces is NOT invariant.
Identify the true invariant: alternating sum Q = sum_{i=1}^{N} (-1)^{i-1} X_i is preserved.
Note that X_1 and X_N are never modified (they are only used as anchors).
Observe that the no-improvement condition is X_i + X_{i+3} >= X_{i+1} + X_{i+2} (convexity).

Derive closed-form: min sum = Q + 2*(X_2 + X_4 + ... + X_{2⌊N/2⌋}) minimized. Since alternating sum is fixed, min S = Q + 2*min(even-indexed sum). The minimum is achieved when sequence is "convex" (differences non-decreasing).
Determine algorithm: repeatedly fix violations X[i]+X[i+3] < X[i+1]+X[i+2] using the operation. This converges in O(N) steps.

Implement the full algorithm: maintain sorted array X (as a list), maintain a set/deque of indices where violation occurs, pop a violation, apply operation, update neighbors, push new violations. Stop when set is empty. Output sum(X).
Test against both sample inputs and verify correctness.
